messages:
elaine-cs: FYI Sequoia Clinic asked for a short UK demo next Thu 09:00-11:00 UTC. they want a temporary QPS bump + UK-edge allowlist so clinicians see consistent latency. renewal flagged as at-risk; success here is high priority. can infra help?
tom-sre: got it. Hosted or Dedicated? need org id, desired peak qps, CIDRs, and rollback plan. also what success metric are we measuring?
elaine-cs: Hosted (PAYG). org id org-sq-203. peak qps requested = 2,200 (baseline ~260). CIDRs: 34.72.90.0/24, 34.72.91.0/24. window 2026-09-02T09:00:00Z -> 2026-09-02T11:00:00Z. target: p95 < 300ms for core flows.
rachel-platform: we can prefer eu-west-2 and apply the proxy allowlist. note: hosted has multi-region fallback; if they require UK-only we need a transient route pin. recommend soft max_qps 2400, circuit-break 3000, and KV-cache prewarm for top prompts.
tom-sre: plan: create temp rate-policy + allowlist, set soft cap 2400 qps, breaker 3000 qps, pin to eu-west-2 for the window, enable token traces and enhanced logs. I'll also add a gradual ramp schedule to avoid warmup spikes. snippet i'll apply:```json
{"org_id":"org-sq-203","temp_policy":{"start":"2026-09-02T09:00:00Z","end":"2026-09-02T11:00:00Z","max_qps":2400,"circuit_break_qps":3000},"allowlist":["34.72.90.0/24","34.72.91.0/24"],"ramp_seconds":600}
```
elaine-cs: ramp_seconds 600 sounds good. i'll also ask them to prewarm at 08:40 UTC with the provided test prompts.
infra-bot: ticket #CS-11458 created -> temp policy + allowlist request. assigned to tom-sre. auto-revoke scheduled at end time.
ops-oncall: capacity confirmed in eu-west-2 for that window; reserving burst nodes. enabling token-level tracing and a short-lived dashboard. will post status to #release-war-room during the session.
noah-ae: i'll join the demo and the renewal call. please share the dashboard link and we'll use p95 + error-rate as renewal signals.
tom-sre: pushed the config -> policy_id=tmp-sq-203-20260902. allowlist applied. dashboard: https://console.redwood.example/org/org-sq-203/session-20260902
ops-oncall: standing by during window; will post 15-min checks and escalate on latency >350ms or any 5xx spike.
elaine-cs: perfect  i'll send the prewarm checklist and ephemeral key instructions to the customer. adding a post-demo feedback form to capture UX and errors. thanks team :thumbsup:
